name: What home repairs improve accessibility for individuals with disabilities?

mainEntity.name: What home repairs improve accessibility for individuals with disabilities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility repairs focus on improving safety, mobility, and ease of use throughout the home. Essential repairs include widening doorways, reinforcing framing to install secure bathroom grab bars, building ramp transitions over uneven flooring, and lowering switch plates or countertops. When deciding which modifications to tackle first, prioritize daily fall risks and high-use areas like bathrooms and primary entrances. Doing custom framing and tile prep early ensures grab bars and fixtures hold up securely over long-term daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key accessibility repairs include doorway widening, reinforced grab bar installation, flush floor transitions, and lower fixtures to improve safety and mobility.
